title: Grok connector tool-index compatibility isolation
summary: Live Grok qualification reached the public dev4 MCP endpoint directly: initialize, tools/list and tools/call all succeeded, while Grok's connected-tool index still published zero Alchemy tools. v0.2-dev5 therefore adds an optional compatibility presentation that advertises only underscore tool identifiers on a separate endpoint while sharing the same Wire service.
invariants: Canonical dotted MCP tool names remain the authoritative project API.
The compatibility presentation advertises exactly eight underscore aliases and no dotted names.
Alias names dispatch to the identical Wire semantic operations and do not create a second authority path.
Advertised tool input schemas omit the optional $schema member and retain JSON boolean additionalProperties: false.
Stateless GET remains HTTP 405 with Allow: POST; do not fake an SSE transport.
If a client imports /mcp-compat but not /mcp, tool-name indexing is implicated; if it imports neither while direct MCP calls pass, the remaining defect is client connector publication.

provenance.claim: Grounded in sealed MCP Project Service v0.2-dev7 package.
